seoTitle: How to Connect USPS to Shopify for Shipping
metaDescription: Enable USPS shipping in Shopify by linking your account, configuring shipping rates, and testing rates at checkout for smooth fulfillment.
intro: USPS is one of the most widely trusted carriers for US shipping, and connecting it to Shopify keeps order fulfillment smooth and cost-effective. This guide covers how to enable USPS in your Shopify shipping settings, link your account, and configure rates for checkout.

steps.heading: Open Shopify shipping settings
steps.body: Navigate to the shipping and delivery section of your Shopify admin to begin the setup.

steps.heading: Add USPS as a carrier
steps.body: Locate the carrier options and add USPS as one of your available shipping providers.

steps.heading: Link your USPS account
steps.body: Connect your USPS account credentials so Shopify can pull live rates and generate shipping labels.

steps.heading: Configure shipping rates
steps.body: Set up the USPS shipping rates and services you want to display to customers at checkout.

steps.heading: Test USPS rates at checkout
steps.body: Run a test order to confirm USPS rates calculate correctly before going live.

faq.question: Do I need a USPS business account to connect it to Shopify?
faq.answer: Having a USPS account, or using Shopify Shipping which includes discounted USPS rates, is generally required for this integration.

faq.question: Is USPS shipping cheaper through Shopify?
faq.answer: Shopify often provides discounted USPS rates compared to retail pricing when you purchase labels directly through the platform.

faq.question: Can I offer both USPS and other carriers at checkout?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add multiple carriers, including USPS, UPS, or FedEx, and let customers choose their preferred option.

faq.question: What should I do if USPS rates aren't showing correctly?
faq.answer: Check your shipping zones, package weights, and carrier settings, as inaccurate package details are a common cause of rate issues.
